#   kind  ∈ enforce-hook | observe-hook | action | counter | observe-counter

# without a test witness. `tools/coverage-map.py` (make check-coverage-static)

#   - a row here names a surface that no longer exists.
# Every row is acknowledged debt. The row count is the ratchet: it must only
# go DOWN. Adding a new uncovered surface requires a visible row here, which
# shows up in review. See TODO.md "full test-coverage-vs-code audit".

# is not yet grepped by a witness. Tracked Phase 3 (P1) of the coverage plan.
